issues.on_page: 2022 Totals: Cash and cash equivalents (claim on cash) 824,528; Cash at county treasurer 16,889; Restricted cash and cash equivalents 722,444 (no total cash line printed)
issues.issue: Cash is a sum the extractor worked out from three printed lines (marked computed, arithmetic correct). The 2026-11-06 ruling says cash is never derived, and Loup_City_FY2024 leaves beginning_cash null for the same statement. The same applies to ending_cash 281,569 = (481,421) + 25,451 + 737,539. A person should decide whether to keep these or set them to null.

issues.on_page: NET POSITION, end of year 1,896,749 (modified cash basis)
issues.issue: FY2023 ending 1,896,749 equals Loup_City_FY2024 business_type.beginning 1,896,749, but FY2024 labels the measure 'cash' while FY2023 labels it 'net position'. The measures differ between years.

issues.on_page: Lottery fund 'Other' 6,018; Statement of Activities p2 prints Lottery 6,018 under Charges for Services
issues.issue: This does not match receipts[12], where the same 6,018 is counted as 'charges for services/fees' (inside the business-type 'Other' 9,246). The same money has two categories. Either fits the page: the Statement of Activities counts it as charges for services, and the lottery-fund rule points to keno/lottery.
This is an assumption. The page does not label it highway allocation, and the Statement of Activities p2 shows Street and Highway operating grants of 200,575, not 214,056.
The Water 'Other' 3,228 is printed as-is, but the line has a 'computed' note that only explains the category. A printed amount could be read as a computed value.
